newsitem.title: USA: Hughes Electronics wins $48 mln contract.
newsitem.headline: Hughes Electronics wins $48 mln contract.

text.p: A unit of Hughes Electronics Corp was awarded a $48 million subcontract from Thomson-CSF to build an air defense communications subsystem for NATO and the Portugese Air Force, the company said on Thursday.

The company said its Hughes Command and Control division would begin work on the four-year contract this month. It will design, test and operate the subsystem until the Portugese Air Force takes control of the entire air defense system in 2000.

"This win once again affirms Hughes Command Systems expertise, leadership and performance in providing overall capability for air defense systems worldwide," said Phil George, president of Hughes Command and Control Systems, said in a statement.
